sections.heading: About us:
sections.content:
Founded by Stanford AI researchers Anirudh Joshi, Damir Vrabac, Viswesh Krishna and Harvard Professor Pranav Rajpurkar
Partnering with the world’s leading oncologists
20+ publications in AI+medicine and backgrounds from tech companies and health tech startups!
Redefining cancer treatment using AI
Building AI diagnostics for the most pressing problems in oncology
Backed by Andreessen Horowitz and Pear VC

sections.heading: About the Role:
sections.content:
Developing commercial systems to be used by thousands of oncologists
Designing data visualization systems for internal ML models
Building production platform for scalable ML inference

sections.heading: What we're looking for:
sections.content:
Front-end development experience in React, JS/TS
Back-end development experience in Python, Rust, C/C++  
(Optional) Experience with GIS / Map systems, Data Visualization
(Optional) Previously deployed HIPAA compliant systems
